scenario.name: WAN connectivity failure
scenario.description: The Singapore WAN circuit loses signal and the branch is isolated from the core.

incident.title: Singapore office cannot reach any corporate service
incident.description: All users in the Singapore branch report that ERP, e-mail and internet access stopped working.

ground_truth.root_cause: Carrier B circuit WAN-SIN-0001 lost signal; LNK-WAN-SIN is down and the BGP session between SIN-RTR-01 and CORE-RTR-01 failed, withdrawing all Singapore routes.
